newsitem.title: USA: U.S corporate bonds flat, trade quiet, eyes on Fed.
newsitem.headline: U.S corporate bonds flat, trade quiet, eyes on Fed.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate bonds prices were little changed in late-session amid almost nonexistent trading as players key in on next week's Federal Reserve policy setting meeting.
"Corporate bonds were basically unchanged in light to nonexistent trading," said one high-grade trader. "People are focusing on Tuesday's (FOMC) meeting."
Secondary market activity was bolstered this week by numerous debt offerings in the primary market which dealers said were met with very good demand and lead to a pickup in trading acitivity.
